title: Riding the L-1011 jump seat posing as FAA

tellings.quote: he'd tell the co-pilot and engineer, "Hey, this guy's from the FAA, so he's just going to be observing us and taking it."

plain: In the 1980s, a man named Bob Lazar says he rode in the cockpit jump seat, the spare seat behind the pilots, of an L-1011 airliner flying from Las Vegas to Minneapolis, passed off as an inspector from the FAA, the federal aviation regulator. Lazar tells Michels his friend John Lear, the pilot, would tell the co-pilot and flight engineer that this guy was from the FAA and was just going to observe. Lazar tells it as part of how he and Lear knew each other, a friendship other stories link to how his larger claims began.
